subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "serves."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Serves" means to give food or drink to somebody during a meal; to take an order and then bring food or drink to somebody in a restaurant, bar, etc. (भोजन परोसना; रेस्‍तराँ, बार आदि में ग्राहकों से आदेश लेकर खाद्य और पेय पदार्थ उन्‍हें पहुँचाना)

 
 
• Example:* She **serves**__ me dinner.*
 
 
 
• This sentence conveys that two modest rooms make up the post office's houseboat: one is used as the office, and the other is a little museum that chronicles the state postal department's philatelic past.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph : 

The post office’s houseboat has two small rooms – one __**serves**__ as the office and the other a small museum that traces the philatelic history of the state postal department. It has a shop that sells postage stamps and other products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Guides: **to help a person or a group of people to find the way to a place; to show somebody a place that you know well. (व्‍यक्ति या व्‍यक्ति समूह को कहीं जाने का रास्‍ता बताना; किसी को वह स्‍थान दिखाना जिसे आप जानते हैं)
 
• **Handles: **to touch or hold something with your hand(s). (हाथ से छूना या सँभालना)
 
• **Directs: **to point or send something towards somebody/something or in a particular direction. (किसी दिशा विशेष की ओर किसी बात का संकेत करना या लक्ष्‍य करन)
